scope: Oxford, Cambridge and Imperial first. Original practice content; admissions formats are researched separately from practice design.

schools.name: Oxford
schools.headline: Reason aloud. Follow the evidence.
schools.summary: Medicine applicants are interviewed by two colleges. Preparation should cover scientific reasoning, intellectual curiosity, communication and personal suitability.
schools.unknowns: Number and length of individual interviews need college-specific confirmation. No universal MMI circuit is inferred.

metric.label: Offers / applications
metric.note: Calculated from 158 quota + 1 deferred + 16 open offers. The eligible-applicant denominator is different (1,026).

schools.name: Cambridge
schools.headline: Apply familiar science to unfamiliar problems.
schools.summary: Subject conversations explore understanding, critical thinking and learning potential. Delivery can be online or in person, depending on the college and applicant circumstances.
schools.unknowns: The university-wide 35–60 minute guidance is not a guaranteed Medicine schedule. The invitation determines interview count, timings and any advance reading.

metric.label: Offers / applications
metric.note: Calculated from Table 1.1, page 4. The report separately records 270 acceptances (17.6%); acceptances are not offers.

schools.name: Imperial
schools.cycle: Current undated format page; 2027 course page
schools.headline: Clear reasoning, delivered under time pressure.
schools.summary: Published themes include teamwork, motivation, the doctor's role, empathy, ethics and interpreting data. Answers receive separate marks for content and communication.
schools.unknowns: Current station count, reading time and transition time are not established by the fetched admissions page. A six-topic practice set is an editorial choice, not a verified six-station circuit.

metric.label: Applications / place
metric.note: Published rounded ratio; cannot be converted into an offer rate. Do not rank beside offer percentages.

queue.name: UCL & King’s
queue.reason: Interview guidance and admissions tables are now in the evidence register. Current station logistics still need invitation-level confirmation.

queue.name: Edinburgh & St Andrews
queue.reason: Scottish fee-status distinctions are explicit. Edinburgh’s conflicting offer totals are flagged; St Andrews’ three A100 cohorts stay separate.

comparisonNote: Founder priority order, not a UK selectivity ranking. Offer rates, acceptance rates and applications per place answer different questions. Cycles, courses and fee-status cohorts must match before ranking schools. UK-wide comparison remains open.

updates.title: 60 original drafts; 21 regression tests passed.
updates.body: Added 34 individually authored exercises, bringing coverage to 35 academic and 38 MMI drafts with 13 shared. Circuit completion, reflection export, repeat avoidance and mobile layout passed browser checks. Type checking and the production build passed.

updates.title: Nine priority course routes have refreshed evidence.
updates.body: Search all 68 inherited routes, with nine refreshed format records and admissions evidence for seven institutions. Each statistic keeps its course, cycle and population. Edinburgh’s inconsistent offer totals are flagged rather than ranked.

updates.title: Build and rehearse a complete practice circuit.
updates.body: Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial and mixed MMI plans assemble from shared drafts. Timers, local repeat history, self-reflection and plan export are available. Editorial timing choices are labelled separately from official facts.

updates.title: Clinical teal and warm coral, one switch away.
updates.body: The supplied Medicine identity is now the default in the lab and dashboard. The persistent palette switch also controls the new landing page. Live interview timers stay aqua.

updates.title: 26 original stations are ready for editorial review.
updates.body: 18 academic-track and 13 MMI-track drafts, with 5 shared across both. Each has two follow-up probes, banded assessment notes and an explicit review requirement. Drafts also appear in the existing admin question-review screen.

updates.title: Desktop and mobile interaction checks passed.
updates.body: At 1440px and 390px: no horizontal overflow or browser exceptions. Theme persistence, school filters, timer controls and saved review notes were exercised. Twelve regression tests passed.

updates.title: Three priorities. Two different interview models.
updates.body: Oxford and Cambridge get an academic reasoning track. Imperial gets timed MMI practice. Unknown format fields stay explicit rather than inheriting Leeds timings.

updates.title: The review gate is a staged-file workflow.
updates.body: The current review screens preview staged JSON. Publication is a reviewed code merge into the runtime bank. New medicine drafts stay in staging and appear in this lab for review.

updates.title: The starting point is larger than the handoff.
updates.body: Counted 122 medicine stations, 68 course routes and 50 institution labels in the local checkout. Two dedicated timed modes exist. Deployed database and production content were not queried.
